title: A3 model queue and failover
summary: The isolated A3 package added bounded queue admission and controlled application-provider failover while keeping builder Anthropic API billing at zero.
evidence: The queue is keyed by authenticated user session or request IP.
Concurrency, queue length, and wait time are bounded, with one retry owner and honest HTTP 503 exhaustion behavior.
Tenant and beta-access checks run before queue admission.
Only the approved provider-selection branch in embed.js changed, and the retrieval lane was notified.
Anthropic application failure falls through to the existing OpenAI path only when the existing OpenAI credential is available.
Thirteen queue tests and five Phase 1 regression tests passed.
The sanitized staging database remained read-only and checksum-identical, and the worktree retained zero Git remotes.
limitations: The isolated package has not been merged or deployed. No live provider credential was exposed to the builder and no production call was made.
